body.link:
<%
        String step = "";
        String soResult = null;
        if(!"true".equals(params.get("isHidden"))){
            SepoaOut so = ServiceConnector.doService(info, "sepoa.svc.system.link.SepoaLinkService", "CONNECTION", "checkLink", new Object[] {params});
            if(so.status == 1){
                step = "HIDE_PARAMS";
                soResult = so.result[0];
            }else{
                step = "ALERT";
                soResult = String.valueOf(so.status);
            }
        }else{
            step = "DRAW_PAGE";
        }
    %>
